posts.title: I’ve watched this happen twice. AI is round three.
posts.description: Twenty years of better dev tools, three turns of the same pattern. AI isn't eating developers, it's eating SaaS. From someone who's seen it before. The post I’ve watched this happen twice. AI is round three. appeared first on Ben Bowler .

posts.title: Apple is now paying Google a billion dollars a year. I think they’re still winning on AI.
posts.description: Apple lost the cloud LLM race so badly they're paying Google a billion a year for Gemini. They're also quietly winning the on-device AI race, and that's the bet I'd take. The post Apple is now paying Google a billion dollars a year. I think they’re still winning on AI. appeared first on Ben Bowler .

posts.title: Tokens for teens
posts.description: The laptop my dad bought me at seventeen put me on a level playing field with Silicon Valley. The LLM token bill is the modern version. The kids without it are starting their working lives with a gap that wasn't there in mine. The post Tokens for teens appeared first on Ben Bowler .
